caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling a candleholder or oil lamp, composed of several geometric components. The base consists of a wide, shallow circular dish with a raised rim, rendered in gray tones. Attached to one edge of the dish is a curved, handle-like extension, also gray, which curls upward and away from the circular base, forming a hook shape. Rising vertically from the center of the dish is a pedestal stem with a flared and angular profile, transitioning from a narrow base to a wider, conical midsection that supports the upper part of the object. The top portion is an inverted truncated cone, also rendered in gray, with a smaller, gold or brass-colored cylindrical cap sitting at the apex, possibly functioning as a lid or burner element. The drawing is centered on an off-white or yellowed background with faint rectangular border lines framing the composition.
title: Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
